fusions.name: Hoof and Fang
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Trample Through
fusions.desc: Tramples every enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage and knocks each back 2 tiles. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 20%).

fusions.name: Tireless Lope
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds.

fusions.name: Saddle-Warm Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.8 seconds. You can ride it.
